summary: Iteration 103: Unified sync module backend testing. All 10 pytest tests passed (status=never, POST insert with UNI_ prefix, replacement of stale running doc, pipelineId-missing error path, cancel cascade across unified+leads+events collections, stale-recovery>30min in /status, fresh<30min preservation, regression of /events/manager-stats fields, lead/event sync-status endpoints). Background _run_unified was not awaited to completion (depends on amoCRM); instead immediately cancelled — per main agent's instructions.

minor.issue: When BG task fires _run_lead_sync via FastAPI BackgroundTasks but pipelineId is missing, the unified doc correctly flips to status=error within ~1s — works as expected. No issue, just noting timing.

critical_code_review_comments: unified_sync.py looks clean and well-scoped (~209 lines). Stale-recovery uses datetime.fromisoformat which is correct for ISO strings with timezone. The cascade in /cancel correctly cancels all 3 collections.

Minor: cancel endpoint cancels ALL running lead_analytics_sync and event_analytics_sync (not only those tied to the unified_id). If a standalone (non-unified) sync is running, it would also be cancelled. Acceptable given UX intent ('one big stop button') but worth documenting.

Minor: When phase 1 leads sync completes with 0 records, leadsProcessed falls back to 0 — progress message will read 'Лиды готовы (0)'. Consider showing 'без новых лидов' for clarity but not blocking.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 (not required — endpoints are unauthenticated like other lead-analytics routes)
seed_data_creation: Test docs inserted into unified_sync, lead_analytics_sync, event_analytics_sync during tests; all cleaned up via cleanup_unified fixture + explicit deletes. Verified post-run: 0 running docs in all 3 collections.

Regression /events/manager-stats still returns filterInfo/syncDateFrom/To/binotelUsed/managers (iter102 contract preserved). When testing future analytics features, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_unified_sync.py as regression. Don't wait for real _run_unified end-to-end — amoCRM is unreachable from preview.
